nodes.title: Contribute to the sustained increase in incomes of rural households by improving the competitiveness of the farming operations
Improve the competitiveness of the farmers through a value chain approach covering production, value addition of high value niche crops, spices and horticulture produce
Outcome 1: Expansion and improved performance of Rural Producers' Organizations (FPOs)
Outcome 2: Enhanced productivity and production (niche and horticultural crops)
Output 2.2: Access to inputs and technology packages
Outcome 3: Improved price realization of Agri and allied farmers
Outcome 4: Improved resilience of vulnerable groups
Output 4.2: Support to other vulnerable groups
Output 5.2: Staff training of Agri and allied Directorates
